summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of ETI EduConnect V1. Backend: 30/30 pytest tests passing (public endpoints, auth, admin CRUD, leads, CSV export, settings). Frontend: home/universities/courses/compare/search/guides/landing pages all render with data. Lead submission via /get-guidance works and returns ETI reference ID. Admin login with seeded credentials succeeds, dashboard shows stats (4 leads, 22 universities, 12 courses), all admin sections (Leads, Universities, Courses, Guides, Landing, Settings) load without errors. Bearer token stored in localStorage as expected. Auth cookies also set httpOnly with samesite=none.

issues: Document <title> is 'Emergent | Fullstack App' - should be customized to ETI EduConnect branding for SEO

action_items: Optional: Update <title> in public/index.html to 'ETI EduConnect - Know What\'s Next.' for branding/SEO.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 321: dedup query compares ISO string created_at with '$gte' since ISO string; string comparison works for ISO but consider storing as BSON date for indexing.

server.py line 499: CORS allow_origins uses '*' from env but allow_credentials=True combined with '*' is invalid per CORS spec; browsers will reject credentialed requests. Consider explicit origins (or Starlette middleware will error). Currently frontend uses Bearer token so it works, but httpOnly cookie flow across origins may fail.
server.py: /admin/{entity}/{slug} generic PUT strips id/_id but does NOT re-slugify or validate slug uniqueness on update - could silently no-op if slug changed in payload without matching existing.
startup seed_admin correctly re-hashes if password differs (playbook compliant).
seed_data_creation: None - relied on backend startup seed (22 universities, 12 courses, 6 guides, 6 landing pages). Created test leads via API which are prefixed TEST_.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — 30 tests, all pass. Use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env. Admin token via POST /api/auth/login. LeadModal uses data-testid lead-* while /get-guidance page form uses guidance-* testids (different components sharing /api/leads POST). Verified CSV export returns text/csv with lead_id column.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues found. All P0 features working end-to-end.
